items.context: Klaus, you were on the research team that went to the Arctic last month, right? For the new project?
items.transcript:
W: Klaus, you were on the research team that went to the Arctic last month, right? For the new project?

W: Yeah-Sabine can't make it, so the project coordinator asked me to take her place.
M: Great, but prepare for the freezing temperatures! I'd recommend getting a heated jacket. The one I have is battery-operated, and there are heating elements inside the fabric. I'll send you a link to the online store. The jacket didn't cost too much.
